notes.title: V0.9993 is here !
notes.content:
🎉 Exciting News! 🎉

We're thrilled to announce the release of Sukfaristo version 0.9993 on Steam! This update brings a host of exciting features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience.

🎵 [b]New Music and Sound Effects:[/b] Immerse yourself in the world of Sukfaristo with captivating music and vibrant sound effects, adding depth to every gameplay moment.

🛠️ [b]Enhanced Stability:[/b] Experience smoother gameplay and fewer glitches with improved stability, making your journey through Sukfaristo even more enjoyable.

🎨 [b]HD Assets:[/b] Say goodbye to placeholders! We've replaced all placeholder assets with brand new high-definition visuals, bringing the charming world of Sukfaristo to life like never before.

🏆 [b]Steam Achievements:[/b] Test your skills and unlock achievements as you progress through the game. Can you collect them all?

🌍 [b]Global Leaderboards:[/b] Compete with players from around the world and see how you stack up against your friends on the global leaderboards.

🌐 [b]Localization:[/b] Sukfaristo now supports both English and French languages, ensuring that players can fully immerse themselves in the game in their preferred language.

Join us on Steam and embark on an unforgettable adventure in Sukfaristo! Update to version 0.9993 today and experience the magic for yourself. See you in the game! ✨
